_comment: Fiche canonique d'un personnage FICTIF. Les champs 'canonical' ne changent pas d'une generation a l'autre : c'est l'identite. Modifier -> incrementer 'version'.

canonical.face: oval face, high cheekbones, straight nose, full lips, light freckles across the nose
canonical.eyes: almond-shaped hazel-green eyes, thick dark eyebrows
canonical.skin: light olive skin with natural texture
canonical.hair: shoulder-length wavy chestnut-brown hair with a side part

style_suffix: natural skin texture, shot on 35mm, soft natural light, shallow depth of field

outfits.casual: wearing a cream knit sweater and light blue straight jeans
outfits.evening: wearing a black satin slip dress and thin gold necklace

references._comment: Images retenues comme references d'identite (dans refs/). La premiere image de refs/face sert au workflow flux2_klein_4b_ref.

seeds._comment: Seeds ayant donne des resultats fideles, par usage (portrait, profil, pied...).

lora._comment: Phase ulterieure : LoRA d'identite entrainee a partir de refs/ (non automatique).
